title: New Application Ideas of Dynamics 365 Business Central (2025 JUN)
summary: A comprehensive list of feature improvement ideas submitted by the Business Central community for the June 2025 release cycle, covering data migration, development tools, financial management, inventory, manufacturing, sales, purchasing, warehousing, and administration across multiple functional areas.
key_points: Community-contributed feature requests span AL development, reporting, financial reconciliation, and system administration
Suggestions address technical gaps like RDLC to Word conversion, OData filtering, and address field handling
Financial management improvements include VAT reconciliation, currency handling, prepayment functionality, and dimension-based grouping
UX enhancements requested include dark mode, conditional formatting, batch operations, and document attachment management
features: OData orderby in financial report API

quotes.text: Would any of these ideas improve Business Central? Here is a list of some of them.
quotes.why_it_matters: Frames the post as a curated collection of community-driven improvement suggestions for the platform
